proposed.text: Under the UAP Code of Ethics, what should an architect do when asked to take over a commission where another architect was previously employed?

options.text: Notify the prior architect in writing and confirm termination and compensation before undertaking the commission
Accept immediately if the owner says the previous architect is no longer wanted
Wait until construction starts before notifying the prior architect
Proceed if the prior architect did not sign a construction contract

proposed.rationale: The Code requires written notice, conclusive termination, and due compensation before undertaking that commission.
